tagline: Miami-Dade lawn care and tree service that shows up

why_choose_us.title: We show up on the day we said
why_choose_us.description: The most common complaint about landscapers in Miami is that they stop answering the phone. Our customers keep writing the opposite — a quote on a Saturday, the crew on site Monday morning.

why_choose_us.title: 224 reviews, 4.9 average, 96% five stars
why_choose_us.description: Twelve years of verified homeowner reviews across Miami-Dade, including customers who have stayed with us seven years running.

why_choose_us.title: One crew for the lawn and the trees
why_choose_us.description: Weekly mowing, tree trimming, removals, stump grinding and sod from the same company. One number to call instead of three.

why_choose_us.title: Licensed, insured, and properly equipped
why_choose_us.description: Bucket and spider lifts, chipper and chip truck, and crews working to OSHA safety regulations and ISA pruning standards — not a ladder and a pickup.

gallery.title: Canopy thinning ahead of storm season
gallery.alt: Tropical South crew member in a branded shirt, hard hat and safety harness trimming a tree from a Niftylift bucket against a clear blue sky
gallery.description: Selective thinning from an aerial lift so the limbs come out clean and the tree keeps its natural shape.

gallery.title: Oak trimmed back off the roofline
gallery.alt: Articulated boom lift positioned in a driveway to reach a mature oak overhanging a single-storey home
gallery.description: Limbs lifted away from the roof and gutters before hurricane season, with the chipper staged on the street.

gallery.title: Lawn brought back, front to back
gallery.alt: Before and after of a poolside back lawn, overgrown on the left and evenly cut with clean edges on the right
gallery.description: Before and after on a regular maintenance account — cut to height, edged, and blown clean off the pool deck.

gallery.title: Date palm cleaned up
gallery.alt: Before and after of a date palm, heavy with dead fronds on the left and pruned back to a clean crown on the right
gallery.description: Dead fronds and seed pods removed without cutting into the live crown.

gallery.title: Tight-access removal by spider lift
gallery.alt: Compact tracked spider lift set up in a narrow side yard beside a two-storey house to reach a large tree
gallery.description: A tracked lift gets us into side yards a bucket truck cannot reach, without tearing up the lawn.

gallery.title: Stump ground out below grade
gallery.alt: Crew member operating a Toro STX-26 tracked stump grinder against a stump beside a wooden fence
gallery.description: Ground below ground level so the spot can be filled and replanted or sodded over.

gallery.title: Everything chipped and hauled away
gallery.alt: Crew member feeding cut branches into a towable chipper on a residential street while a bucket lift works the tree behind
gallery.description: The debris leaves with us the same day — nothing stacked at the curb waiting on a second trip.

gallery.title: Full removal, site cleared
gallery.alt: Sectioned trunk and root mass cut down to grade with the surrounding hedge left intact
gallery.description: Sectioned down in pieces so nothing swung into the hedge or the neighbouring property.

services_section.subtitle: Residential, commercial and HOA properties across Miami-Dade — weekly maintenance, tree work, stump grinding and sod, handled by the same crew.

closing_cta.headline: Get a free estimate from a crew that calls you back
closing_cta.body: Twelve years in Miami-Dade, 224 verified reviews at a 4.9 average, licensed and insured. Tell us what the property needs and we will get you a price — no charge for the visit.

blog_section.heading: Yard & Tree Advice for South Florida
blog_section.description: Practical guidance on lawns, palms and storm prep for Miami-Dade homeowners, from the crew that works these yards every week.
